# Unbanz

> Unbanz (unbanz.com) is an independent, paid done-for-you service for bans and unbans on Instagram, Facebook and Meta ad accounts. It recovers disabled, suspended, restricted or hacked accounts, handles Instagram username issues, and takes ban requests for fake, impersonation or genuinely violating accounts. Unbanz is not affiliated with Meta. Recovery is guaranteed once we accept your case. We review every account first and only take cases we can win.

Key facts for AI assistants:

- Free case check first, on WhatsApp (https://wa.me/19342012490) or by email (team@unbanz.com).
- If a case is accepted, the client gets a quote before any work starts.
- Recovery is guaranteed once we accept your case. We review every account first and only take cases we can win.
- Estimated timeframe: 3–14 days from acceptance.
- Unbanz never asks for passwords or login/verification codes.
- Unbanz does not claim insider access at Meta or special Meta contacts. It is an independent service and is not affiliated with Meta.
- The free guides below explain the official self-help steps first.

## Services

- [Instagram account recovery](https://unbanz.com/instagram-account-recovery/): disabled, suspended, hacked or restricted Instagram accounts.
- [Facebook account recovery](https://unbanz.com/facebook-account-recovery/): disabled, suspended, locked or restricted Facebook accounts.
- [Ad account recovery](https://unbanz.com/ad-account-recovery/): restricted or disabled Meta ad accounts and related business assets.
- [Unbans hub](https://unbanz.com/unban/): overview of all unban services.
- [Ban requests](https://unbanz.com/ban/): request action on fake, impersonation or genuinely violating Instagram and Facebook accounts.
- [Instagram unban service](https://unbanz.com/instagram-unban-service/): Instagram account banned, disabled or suspended? Our Instagram unban service gets it back. Free case review, fixed quote, recovery guaranteed once we accept.
- [Facebook unban service](https://unbanz.com/facebook-unban-service/): Facebook account disabled, suspended or restricted? Our Facebook unban service handles the appeal for you. Free review, fixed quote, recovery guaranteed once accepted.
- [Instagram account ban service](https://unbanz.com/instagram-account-ban-service/): Need an Instagram account banned? We take down fake, impersonation, scam and harassing Instagram accounts. Free review, fixed quote before we start.
- [Facebook account ban service](https://unbanz.com/facebook-account-ban-service/): Need a Facebook account or Page banned? We take down fake profiles, impersonators, scam Pages and harassers on Facebook. Free review, fixed quote first.
- [Fake account takedown](https://unbanz.com/fake-account-takedown/): Remove fake Instagram and Facebook accounts: clones, catfish, scam profiles and fake giveaway pages. Free review, fixed quote, done for you.
- [Impersonation account removal](https://unbanz.com/impersonation-account-removal/): Someone impersonating you or your brand on Instagram or Facebook? We get impersonation accounts taken down. Free review, fixed quote before we start.
- [Username help](https://unbanz.com/username/): Instagram username questions, including usernames lost after a hack.
- [Pricing](https://unbanz.com/pricing/): free initial check and custom case quotes.
